name: job-application-agent
description: Privacy-first Agent Skill and CLI for evidence-based job discovery, application completion, and outcome tracking. Verified résumé facts only, OS-backed secrets, confirmed submissions.

interface.longDescription:
Find roles that fit, send truthful applications, and approve every submit yourself. Job Application Agent helps Codex run your own job search end to end: it finds direct employer and ATS postings, filters out weak fits against the rules you set, completes applications using only facts from one verified résumé, and counts a job as applied only after a visible confirmation.

By default you review every submission, one job at a time. Automatic submission is possible only when you explicitly enable it for an authorized destination or batch and every eligibility check passes; the browser's and Codex's own confirmation prompts always still apply. The agent pauses for sign-in, CAPTCHA, sponsorship ambiguity, legal or demographic questions, and anything outside your rules.

Who it is for: people applying to roles on their own behalf who want fewer, better-targeted applications rather than volume. Limitations: it does not guarantee interviews or offers, it relies on the browser and tools your agent host provides, and it stops for anything it cannot verify.

How it works: this plugin ships Agent Skill guidance only, with no MCP server, apps, or hooks. With your confirmation, the companion npm CLI (npx job-application-agent@latest install) installs the full runtime: scripts, references, and a managed updater. Profile facts stay in OS-backed secret storage (macOS Keychain, Windows Credential Manager, or Linux Secret Service), and ledgers stay owner-only on your machine. It never stores passwords, MFA codes, government IDs, CAPTCHA answers, or browser session secrets. Free and open source under the MIT License.

Cloud access, coming soon: a hosted agent that runs this same loop for you. Founding access can be reserved at jobappagent.com, and we email you when access opens.
capabilities: Complete applications from verified résumé facts
defaultPrompt: Help me set up Job Application Agent and install the CLI runtime.
Assess this job posting against my verified profile and eligibility rules.
Walk me through applying to an authorized job URL with confirmed submission tracking.
